prompt: Act as the incident commander. We have a 5xx spike on checkout, payment failures, and customer complaints from NA. Give me an incident brief, first 15-minute plan, risks, rollback criteria, and customer comms draft.

Review this production checkout design from an SRE perspective: frontend -> API gateway -> payments service -> Postgres. Target availability is 99.9%, peak traffic is 500 requests/minute, and the main concerns are payment failures, duplicate charges, DB saturation, and slow checkout. Give me risks, SLIs/SLOs, alerts, observability gaps, and highest-priority improvements.

Create a technical triage checklist for the on-call engineer for a checkout 5xx spike. Include metrics, logs, dashboards, database checks, dependency checks, and rollback validation steps. Prioritize read-only checks first.

Draft customer-facing incident communications for a checkout outage affecting North America. Include initial update, internal note, support guidance, and resolved update. Keep it concise and avoid overcommitting to root cause.
We suspect checkout pods are unhealthy in Kubernetes. What read-only checks should we run first, and what evidence would indicate CrashLoopBackOff, bad rollout, or node pressure?
As an SRE reviewing AWS spend, what should I ask the AWS Cost agent to analyze for a month-over-month cost spike? Include service, account, tag, daily average, and exclude Support/Tax views.
Review this alerting problem: checkout latency alert pages every night but resolves without action. Give me an SRE plan to reduce pager noise without hiding real incidents.
Create a post-incident review outline for a payments outage. Include timeline, impact, contributing factors, detection gaps, action items, owners, and follow-up metrics.
